title: Recurring revenue dashboard with per-plan cohort breakdown
body: We currently eyeball MRR in a spreadsheet. A dashboard that splits active subscriptions by plan, with a 30/60/90-day retention cohort view, would replace three manual exports a week. Bonus points for a CSV of the underlying rows.
admin_response: Cohorts are the single most requested analytics feature — slotted for the analytics revamp. Design preview lands in the changelog first.

title: Slack notifications when a post I voted on changes status
body: I want to know the moment something I upvoted moves to Planned or Shipped. Email works but a Slack message with the status badge and a deep link would land where the team already lives.
admin_response: Under active build. Webhook plumbing is done; the Slack app review is the long pole.

title: Design token theming for customer-facing boards
body: Let me point the public board at my own token set — brand color, radius, font — so the feedback page stops looking like it belongs to a different product. A simple CSS variable override panel would be enough.
admin_response: Shipped as Board Theming in the appearance tab of board settings.

title: Merge duplicate posts automatically before they split the vote
body: Three people filed 'dark mode' three ways this month and each collected votes. Suggesting near-duplicates at submit time — or a one-click merge for admins that pools the votes — would keep demand signal honest.
admin_response: Shipped: duplicate suggestions at submit time plus admin merge with vote pooling.

title: Custom fields on feedback posts
body: Let admins add structured fields — account tier, product area, severity — so the board can be filtered like a real database instead of searched like a mailbox.

title: Weekly digest email of top open posts
body: A Monday digest with the five highest-voted open requests and anything that just moved on the roadmap. Enough to keep the team subscribed without another Slack channel.

title: Public API with webhook subscription for status changes
body: Everything the Slack integration does, but as a documented REST API plus outgoing webhooks, so we can wire feedback events into our own tooling.
admin_response: Declined for now — the current single-tenant data model makes safe multi-customer API scopes a rewrite, not a feature. Revisiting after the multi-workspace split.

title: Vote count desyncs between board list and post detail
body: The board list showed 214 votes, clicking through showed 209, a refresh showed 214 again. Looks like a cached aggregate racing the live count on the detail endpoint.
admin_response: Reproduced — the list reads a denormalized counter while detail recomputes. Fix rides along with the vote-event pipeline.

title: Comment box loses draft when the session expires mid-typing
body: Wrote a three-paragraph reply, hit submit, got logged out, and the text was gone. Either warn before expiry or keep the draft in localStorage and restore it after re-login.

title: Board slug collisions on rename create dead links
body: Renaming a board to a slug that an archived board already held silently broke every external link to the old slug. Either reject the rename or redirect.
admin_response: Shipped: renames now generate a collision-free slug and the old slug 308-redirects.

title: Two-way GitHub link: roadmap item to pull request
body: When a planned post has a tracking issue, show the PR/issue state right on the roadmap card, and post back to the issue when the feature ships. Closed-loop from request to release note.
admin_response: Confirmed with the platform team — the roadmap card gets a live issue chip, shipping posts a closing comment.

title: Import historical feedback from a CSV
body: We have two years of feature requests in a spreadsheet. An importer that maps columns to boards and preserves original dates would let us start with real signal instead of a blank board.

title: Linear sync for the in-progress column
body: Anything an admin marks in-progress should appear as a Linear issue in the project we pick, and status changes should flow both directions.

title: The changelog page is the first one my execs actually read
body: Shipped items with dates and plain-language summaries have replaced our quarterly 'what did product even do' deck. Please never remove it.

title: Dark theme for the whole app
body: Please add a proper dark theme across the boards, roadmap, and admin views — my eyes at 11pm beg you.

title: Add dark mode to the web app
body: A system-following dark mode for boards, roadmap, and the admin views. Every tool I live in all day has one; this is the last bright tab.

title: Mobile: vote button requires two taps on iOS Safari
body: First tap focuses, second tap registers. Suspect the touch target is behind a sticky header on small viewports.
